assertions.name: delta_q(T_{2,k}) = h*[k]_q exactly for all basis-knot exponents

description: Symbolic (sympy) proof that the q-dimension decoration delta_q(T_{2,k}) = q^k - q^{-k} equals h*[k]_q exactly, h = q - q^{-1}, for the basis-knot exponents k in {3,5,7,9,10} (the alpha_{basis-knot} couplings). A polynomial identity in R = Z[q^{+-1/2}, h^{-1}] — pre-archimedean, no pi. This is the reset-resilient cross-check for the trivial field_simp Lean formalisation (step 4 of the alpha_{basis-knot} program).

data.finding: delta_q(T_{2,k}) = q^k - q^{-k} = h*[k]_q is an exact polynomial identity in R = Z[q^{+-1/2}, h^{-1}] (no pi), verified symbolically for the basis-knot exponents {3,5,7,9,10}. The Lean formalisation is the trivial field_simp proof of deltaQ q k = (q - q^{-1}) * qbracket q k; this sympy proof is the reset-resilient cross-check while the Lean env is restoring.
